I've been buying these for 8 years for our Jenn-Air fridge, replacing every 4-5 months. They recently changed the brand name, but the product works as usual, never had an issue.

UPDATE Jan 2017: As others have confirmed, the new brand is not consistent. I've now been through three filters, each time after two months the water flow dropped to one-third the rated amount. I called the company however since I purchased it from Amazon they could not replace it. If this happens to you and you really need this model of filter, buy direct from the number on the back of the packaging. Price is similar and they will send a replacement even after several months if you complain. Not worth the risk of getting a dud from Amazon (sorry).

These filter do not fit my refrigerator and I am out $68. I asked questions to make sure these would fit my model of refrigerator and was assured they would. Since I had not use for them right away they were stored away until just now when the "change filter" signal came on. When I took the filter out of the fridge to replace with these they would not fit. Now it is too late to send them back and I spent nearly $70 on filters I can not use.
Be aware, they will say it will fit your fridge model but it might not. Stick with the brand names.

I used to purchase these when they were [[ASIN:B0049IA8QK Whirlpool W10295370 FILTER1 Refrigerator Water Filter]] ... and they worked okay. They were nothing special, and the price is shocking for a what you get. I don't have the initiative or tools to take a bandsaw to one of these filters, but I bet there isn't any magic going on inside this cartridge, other than the neat trick of getting you to pay 20x what it costs to make the thing every 6 months.

After two years of paying for these things, I decided to research alternatives. I installed one of these at the top of the fridge:
[[ASIN:B000E77I0Y Watts 5YR Premier Filter 5-Year/20,000-Gallon Inline Ice Maker Water Filter]]
The economics are pretty self-evident. Even if you find yourself unable to install this filter, a handy friend or neighbor might be able to help you out for the price of a 12-pack of their favorite adult beverage. Go that route and save yourself enough money for fun things here on Amazon. Plus the water taste and quality seems comparable to me, perhaps even better.

I put a label in the fridge with the date of when I installed this 5-year filter so I know when to replace it -- and I just reset the stupid alert on the refrigerator door whenever it comes on.
It is loud, but understanding how the filter works, I love to hear it! It lets me know it's working! I noticed my water tastes AND looks better now.
